text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she missed out on 1st place in the 
Japanese Derby, <chrname>'s performance undeniably 
captured the hearts of several spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"If <chrname> is in, I might just become a 
supporter of 'Project L'Arc'..." Voices 
like that could be heard everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Expectations for <chrname> are steadily growing. 
Watching this unfold up close, Mei Satake 
renews her determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's make the next Inter-National Series 
even bigger than the last. Let's make it a 
battle worthy of Japan's representative, 
they resolved.
